CustomField.description: A random value generated by WebsuiteDomainController.addDomain, meant to be published by the customer in their own DNS (a TXT record) to prove control of the domain. Not a secret — it's designed to be made public — so unlike this org's session tokens it is stored and shown as plain text, never hashed. Nothing checks it yet; the actual DNS lookup is G1d.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Publish this value in a DNS TXT record to verify ownership (checked by a future milestone).
CustomField.label: Verification Token
